candidate.title: GRO-seq / BRIC-Seq
candidate.scope: Assigned middle row of the Illumina poster, labeled GRO-seq / BRIC-Seq. Expanded labels are Global run-on-sequencing (GRO-seq) and 5′-Bromo-uridine immunoprecipitation chase (BRIC-Seq). Inventory: nascent RNA at a chromatin-associated polymerase; Br-UTP stars and Run-on with analog; free short RNA after Isolate and hydrolyze; capture on an antibody-coated bead; free RNA after Elute / Cap removal / End Repair; blue cDNA after Reverse transcription amplification. Arrows form a single drawn route with no split or pooling. The neighboring RAP and Bru-Seq rows and partial chemical structures at the right are contextual, not additional target workflows or branches. GRO-seq is represented by the drawn run-on/fragment route. BRIC-Seq remains an in-scope distinct assay; its cellular pulse–chase and total-RNA recovery interface is resolved from the source-listed Tani implementation and represented separately to avoid passing run-on/hydrolyzed GRO RNA into BRIC operations. Shared purposes do not imply identical complete implementations. No historical-development or interchangeability claim is made.

operations.label: Run-on with analog
operations.description: Extend polymerase-associated nascent RNA in isolated nuclei while incorporating the BrUTP analog, producing BrU-tagged nuclear run-on RNA. The polymerase icon is the catalyst/context for RNA extension, not a new material product.
operations.mechanism: Already engaged polymerases incorporate the ribonucleotide analog during nuclear run-on; new initiation is prohibited in the Core implementation.
operations.information_effect: Introduces a selectable BrU mark on RNA extended by engaged polymerases; the assay captures run-on-competent transcription complexes. Run-on competence limits detection: the reviewed assay does not induce arrested or terminating complexes to run on, so signal is not a census of all physically bound polymerase.

method_scopes.rationale: The title and expanded name explicitly make BRIC-Seq a grouped target, distinct from GRO-seq. Tani identifies the scoped implementation as cellular BrU pulse–chase, total-RNA isolation, immunopurification and RNA-seq library preparation. Its supported shared purposes are antibody enrichment, RNA recovery and a cDNA sequencing interface.
